note: Verify pass 2026-09-11. Four trees delivered from the Orto Botanico di Pisa (the world's oldest university botanical garden, founded 1543/44), all corroborated by multiple independent sources but garden-entrance-level pin precision only (approximate). The MASAF national register's nearby candidates within 20km are mostly the Lucca Orto Botanico cluster already published/leaded under data/leads/lucca.json (16.3-16.5km, marked 'within 80m of a live tree' by passcheck) or already blocked there (the Massa Pisana camellia). Time-boxed pass; did not chase every remaining candidate.

leads.name: The Sequoia of 1868 and the Araucaria of 1872
leads.species: Sequoia sempervirens (per travelstales.it, though the register elsewhere sometimes uses 'sequoia californiana' loosely) and Araucaria sp.
leads.why: Named on a visitor write-up (travelstales.it) of the Orto Botanico's Scuola Botanica arboretum, alongside the Virginia oak delivered as psa_004: a redwood planted 1868 and an araucaria planted 1872, the latter given as 25m tall. Not chased to a second source this pass, and no girth found. Worth a follow-up pass if the city grows past four; same garden, same access and precision situation as psa_001-004.

leads.name: MASAF register platano orientale (Q55742951 / italy-masaf.json)
leads.why: 12.6 km from Pisa centre (passcheck's register sweep), also carried as a Wikidata candidate (Q55742951, 'Dichiarazione di notevole interesse pubblico'). Not investigated this pass: the coordinate sits north-east of the city on the way to Lucca/San Giuliano Terme, distinct from the garden's own platano orientale (psa_003, which is a different tree inside the Orto Botanico itself and has its own unresolved species-name conflict). Needs a location check (which comune, is it on public or private ground) before it can be judged; may end up folded into a Lucca-side cluster rather than a Pisa one given the distance from central Pisa.

leads.name: MASAF register cipresso calvo
leads.why: 10.1 km from Pisa centre per passcheck's register sweep, girth 3.5m. Not investigated this pass beyond the register listing; no access or second source checked. Location is southwest/south of the city, direction and access unconfirmed.
